from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,stat
targets=['/root/.claude-server-commander','/home/ubuntu/.claude-server-commander']
print('=== COMMANDER CLEANUP PREFLIGHT ===')
for name in targets:
 p=Path(name)
 print('DIR',name,'PRESENT',p.exists(),'SYMLINK',p.is_symlink(),'OWNER',(str(p.stat().st_uid)+':'+str(p.stat().st_gid)) if p.exists() else 'none')
 if not p.is_dir() or p.is_symlink():continue
 for c in sorted(p.iterdir()):
  kind='link' if c.is_symlink() else 'dir' if c.is_dir() else 'file'
  rc=subprocess.run(['du','-x','-s','-B1',str(c)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
  print('CHILD',c.name,kind,rc.stdout.split()[0] if rc.returncode==0 and rc.stdout else '?')
 print('FILE_COUNT',sum(len(fs) for _,_,fs in os.walk(name)))
print('=== LIVE PROCESSES ===')
for pid in Path('/proc').iterdir():
 if not pid.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  raw=(pid/'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\0',b' ').decode(errors='replace')
  cwd=os.readlink(pid/'cwd')
  exe=os.readlink(pid/'exe')
  needles=('/.claude-server-commander','claude-server-commander')
  if any(x in cwd or x in exe or x in raw for x in needles):
   if 'python3 -' in raw and 'commander' in raw:continue
   print('USING',pid.name,'CWD',cwd[:120],'EXEC',exe[:120])
 except OSError:pass
print('=== LINK_REFERENCES ===')
for root in ['/etc/systemd/system','/etc/cron.d','/usr/local/sbin','/root/.pm2','/home/ubuntu/codex-bridge','/srv/lowcost-europa','/srv/pink-iptv','/srv/fadego-staging']:
 base=Path(root)
 if not base.exists():continue
 count=0
 for dirpath,dirs,files in os.walk(root):
  depth=len(Path(dirpath).parts)-len(base.parts)
  if depth>3:dirs.clear();continue
  dirs[:]=[x for x in dirs if x not in ('.git','node_modules','.venv','releases','build','jobs','tests')]
  for f in files:
   p=Path(dirpath)/f
   try:
    if p.is_symlink() or p.stat().st_size>350000:continue
    if p.suffix not in ('.service','.timer','.js','.py','.json','.sh','.yml','.yaml','.conf','.md','.toml'):continue
    if 'claude-server-commander' in p.read_text(errors='replace'):
     print('REF_FILE',str(p));count+=1
   except OSError:pass
 print('REF_SCAN',root,count)
print('=== OTHER LARGE CACHES ===')
for p in ['/root/.gradle/caches','/home/ubuntu/.npm','/root/.npm','/home/ubuntu/.local/share/motor-ferrari/.runtime/npm-cache','/home/ubuntu/.cache','/root/.cache']:
 rc=subprocess.run(['du','-x','-s','-B1',p],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
 print('CACHE',p,rc.stdout.split()[0] if rc.returncode==0 and rc.stdout else 'ABSENT')
print('PREFLIGHT_DONE')
PY
